script: Florida club tryouts don't just happen whenever. State rules say they can't start before May first, and the start date has to land by the Tuesday after Memorial Day. Each region picks its date inside that window. So the time to visit clubs and ask questions is before May, not after.
caption:
Florida club tryouts have a start date 📅

Under FYSA Rule 401.6, the statewide tryout date can be no earlier than May 1 and no later than the Tuesday after Memorial Day, and each region can pick its own date inside that window. Always confirm your club's exact dates.

That means the best time to visit clubs, watch a practice and ask questions is before May. Save this and share it with a soccer parent.
